summary: Frontend-only targeted regression check completed for chat composer tools toggle. Static code validation confirms undefined setter reference was removed and replaced with pinned formatting state. Web preview probe on /chat/[conversationId] showed no crash/minimize behavior when repeatedly tapping the tools button in this unauthenticated environment.

integration_issues.issue: Could not fully reproduce/validate native Android minimize behavior in this run because testing was limited to web preview and unauthenticated context.
Initial preview attempt timed out while tunnel was recovering; subsequent attempts loaded successfully.

action_items: Run native Android authenticated validation on a real conversation and tap composer-toolbar-tools repeatedly to confirm no app minimize/backgrounding.
Verify composer-tools-wrap visibility toggles as expected in a conversation-available state (web unauth probe cannot reliably exercise this state).
Stabilize Expo tunnel startup in CI preview (ngrok/tunnel retries observed).
critical_code_review_comments: No remaining references to undefined setShowComposerFormatting(...) were found in frontend/app or frontend/src.

chat/[conversationId].tsx now uses showComposerFormattingPinned state with safe functional toggle and explicit open/close side effects (focus on open, blur + Keyboard.dismiss + color picker reset on close).
Lint run shows existing non-blocking warnings in chat screen (missing useCallback deps around refetchMessages), but no compile-time indicator of the original undefined setter bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run used unauthenticated web preview only. Direct route /chat/12345678901 renders chat shell with unavailable-state body. Tapping tools button did not crash the page, but formatter visibility did not change in this state, so native authenticated retest is required for final confidence.
rca_of_issue: Reported root cause aligns with code: handler previously invoked an undefined setter at tap time, which would throw runtime errors. Current file uses a real state setter (setShowComposerFormattingPinned), eliminating that specific undefined-function failure path. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
